hooks.command: echo 'DATASAURUS GATE: before writing ANY number into a document, notebook, bitacora or commit — G1 render the object, G2 compare elements in a COMMON COORDINATE (match every nuisance dimension your statistic responds to), G3 look at your own knobs, G4 read it against a mechanism. A plot of your statistic is not a render of your object. || TEACHING: if the user says they do not understand, diagnose WHICH gap (goal/object/notation/mechanism/significance), choose the medium (prose for a fact, code-led, or the full ladder for a behaviour), build the smallest runnable instance, plot the object, turn a knob, and offer routes not a yes/no. Enrich an existing notebook before creating a new one. || THE JOIN: a fact may be told, a behaviour must be run — and an EXPLANATION that quotes one of OUR numbers is a report, so it passes the datasaurus gates unchanged. No number of ours enters prose without its reference distribution in the SAME sentence.'
